title: Phase 1: Intake
goal: Capture each inbound ticket from customer prose into a trusted structured record.
unlocks: A validated ticket record the classification and priority steps read.

title: Phase 2: Classification
goal: Assign each ticket a category against the governed intent taxonomy.
unlocks: A category the priority and routing steps depend on.

title: Phase 3: Priority
goal: Score each ticket's priority from the governed impact-by-urgency matrix.
unlocks: A matrix-derived priority (P1-P4) that routing acts on.

title: Phase 4: Routing
goal: Map category and priority to a queue, escalating P1s and logging standard assignments.
unlocks: Every ticket in the right queue, with P1s escalated and captured.

title: Phase 5: Resolution and Learning
goal: Track SLA timers, capture resolutions, catch misroutes, assemble the digest, and feed taxonomy tuning.
unlocks: The 5:00 PM queue-health digest and the misroutes that tune tomorrow's taxonomy.
